title: etl: Fix some warnings
description:
extcap\etl.c(1371,77): warning C4133: 'function':incompatible types
- from 'DWORD *' to 'PBYTE'

   Cast the DWORD pointer to a PBYTE. Note that the function, being a
   Win32 API, always retrieves multibyte values in Little Endian.

etl.c(1189,44): warning C4133: 'function':incompatible types - from
'uint32_t *' to 'const guint8 *'

   This doesn't overly matter, but use an array.

extcap\etl.c(604,43): warning C4113: 'void (__cdecl *)(etw_frag *)'
differs in parameter lists from 'GHFunc'

   A GHFunc has as parameters the key, value, and userdata. The function
   passed in has one parameter, which takes the etw_frag*, i.e. will
   be mapped to the key, not the value. That's a bug. Use the free
   function as the value destroy function in g_hash_table_free_full.

AI-Assisted: no
